stem: The American public was divided about President Clinton’s impeachment. What was one argument presented by people who disagreed with the impeachment proceedings?

options.label: A
options.text: The rule of law did not apply to members of the executive branch.

options.label: B
options.text: Executive privilege did not apply to matters of national security.

options.label: C
options.text: Poor judgment in private behaviors did not qualify as high crimes and misdemeanors.

options.label: D
options.text: Bribery and corruption did not need to be investigated by an independent counsel.

visual_elements:
On Jan. 7, 1999, the U.S. Senate convened as a court to try articles of impeachment against Democratic Pres. Bill Clinton. It was only the second time in U.S. history that a president had been tried by the Senate.
    
    —"Prosecuting the President," Encyclopedia Britannica, www.britannica.com (accessed February 3, 2019)
